tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Returns one published Kirah business catalog with current services, providers, timezone, prices, durations, deposit requirements, intake-question definitions and derived booking capabilities.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Ranks up to five services in one published Kirah business catalog against a short free-text query. Returns catalog-grounded candidate identifiers, names, scores and match evidence.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Returns current open times for one exact service and optional provider over a YYYY-MM-DD range of up to 31 days, with at most 20 rows. Approval-mode times are preferences rather than holds.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Searches Kirah's eligible public business directory by service need or exact Kirah Agent Address, with optional coarse location, price and demo-mode filters. Demo results are explicitly labeled.

tools.name: find_available_services
tools.description: Checks up to five top matching eligible Kirah businesses for earliest current availability within an exact ISO-8601 window of up to 14 days. Returns checked status and a partial-coverage flag.

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Returns the current status, time, service and provider for one grant-authorized booking reference. Client contact details and intake responses are excluded.

tools.name: get_reschedule_options
tools.description: Returns up to five real alternate times and the current fee or approval consequences for one grant-authorized booking. It does not hold, move or cancel the appointment.

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.description: Atomically moves one grant-authorized booking to a real open time after explicit user confirmation. Reusing idempotency_key makes retries safe. Failure leaves the original booking unchanged; success returns a rotated grant.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels one grant-authorized booking after explicit user confirmation. Reusing idempotency_key makes retries safe. Kirah refuses cancellations that could refund a charged deposit or restore a paid plan session; an allowed cancellation has no undo.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Creates one guest booking for an exact service, provider and ISO-8601 start time after explicit user confirmation. Reusing idempotency_key makes retries safe.
